requirements.desc: `senti flow prepare --worktree` runs a preflight for required branch-reflected files before prepare-state cleanup/deletion and before invoking `git worktree add`.
requirements.note: R1: halts before worktree and branch side effects when required config is unreflected

requirements.desc: The preflight fails before side effects when `.senti/config.json` does not exist in the selected base/HEAD checkout that would be used for the new worktree.
requirements.note: R2: reports missing branch-reflected config before git worktree add

requirements.desc: The preflight fails before side effects when `.senti/config.json` has staged, unstaged, or untracked local state that would not be reflected in the new worktree checkout.
requirements.note: R3: reports staged config changes that would not be reflected

requirements.desc: A preflight failure preserves any `--run-id` preparing state and returns a clear halt envelope or prompt context containing the required file path, detected status, reason it will not be reflected in the worktree, and recovery choices for commit-and-continue or abort.
requirements.note: R4: preserves preparing state on required config halt

requirements.desc: When `.senti/config.json` is reflected in the selected base/HEAD checkout, `--worktree` prepare preserves existing successful behavior, including worktree creation, spec artifact creation, docs scan, `.senti/config.local.json` overlay sync, and plugin runtime sync.
requirements.note: R5: succeeds and preserves local overlay sync when config is branch-reflected

requirements.desc: The change does not modify branch mode or no-branch prepare behavior and does not auto-copy `.senti/config.json` into the worktree or auto-commit it.
requirements.note: R6: does not apply the required config halt to no-branch prepare
